اختلسنا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَسْنَا (iḵtalasnā) /ix.ta.las.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
# اُخْتُلِسْنَا (uḵtulisnā) /ux.tu.lis.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِخْتَلَسَ (iḵtalasa)
